analysis.reasonEn: Despite the RSI uptrend from 32.3 to 32.5 to 38.5 over the last 3 trading days, the MACD histogram has continued to worsen from -0.1025 to -1.4828. The current price of $347.30 is in a sideways range, down 5.6% from the 5-day high of $366.78 and up 3.4% from the 20-day low of $335.81. The weekly ADX at 30.0 indicates a clear trend, but the daily momentum indicators are mixed, showing a lack of directional conviction. With the target allocation of 1x filled, leverage review is pending stronger signals, thus maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
